title: lilium catesbaei subsp. longii
intro: Lilium catesbaei subsp. longii, commonly known as the Appalachian Turk's Cap Lily, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the lily family. This plant is known for its unique, curved flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lilium catesbaei subsp. longii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used to treat a range of health conditions, including fever reduction and pain relief.
